Figure S1.
Load libraries.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
```

Download TCGA-LUSC data.
```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)

# Define the query for SKCM transcriptome profiling
query_lusc <- TCGAbiolinks::GDCquery(
    project = "TCGA-LUSC",
    data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
    data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
    workflow.type = "STAR - Counts" # Standard GDC harmonization pipeline
)

TCGAbiolinks::GDCdownload(query_lusc)

data_lusc <- TCGAbiolinks::GDCprepare(query_lusc)

# Extract expression matrix
expr_matrix_tpm_lusc <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(data_lusc,
                                                "tpm_unstrand"   # choose "unstranded" for raw counts
                                                )

expr_matrix_raw_lusc <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(data_lusc,
                                                "unstranded"   # choose "unstranded" for raw counts
                                                )

# Extract clinical metadata
clinical_lusc <- as.data.frame(colData(data_lusc))
```

```{r}
# This function perform filtering protein-coding genes, convert from ENSEMBL to symbols, and aggregate duplicated genes.
process_expression_matrix <- function(expr_matrix, se_object, agg_func = mean) {
  
  # 1. Extract annotation and filter for protein_coding
  gene_info <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::rowRanges(se_object))
  # Ensure we have the IDs as a column
  gene_info$ensembl_id <- rownames(gene_info)
  
  protein_coding_genes <- gene_info$ensembl_id[gene_info$gene_type == "protein_coding"]
  
  # 2. Subset matrix to only protein-coding IDs present in the matrix
  common_ids <- intersect(rownames(expr_matrix), protein_coding_genes)
  expr_sub <- expr_matrix[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # 3. Create mapping vector (Ensembl ID -> Gene Symbol)
  # subset gene_info to only those in the matrix for performance
  mapping_vec <- setNames(gene_info$gene_name[match(rownames(expr_sub), gene_info$ensembl_id)], 
                          rownames(expr_sub))
  
  # 4. Remove rows with no mapping (NAs)
  valid_rows <- !is.na(mapping_vec)
  expr_final <- expr_sub[valid_rows, , drop = FALSE]
  symbols <- mapping_vec[valid_rows]
  
  # 5. Aggregate duplicates
  # rowsum works by summing; for mean, we compute sum / count
  if (identical(agg_func, mean)) {
    counts <- as.vector(table(symbols)[symbols])
    sum_matrix <- rowsum(expr_final, group = symbols, reorder = FALSE)
    return(sum_matrix / counts)
  } else {
    return(rowsum(expr_final, group = symbols, reorder = FALSE))
  }
}
```

Use process_expression_matrix to clean expression matrix.
```{r}
# Clean TCGA-LUAD
clean_expr_matrix_tpm_luad <- process_expression_matrix(expr_matrix = expr_matrix_tpm_luad,
                                                    se_object = data_luad,
                                                    agg_func = mean)

# Clean TCGA-LUSC
clean_expr_matrix_tpm_lusc <- process_expression_matrix(expr_matrix = expr_matrix_tpm_lusc,
                                                    se_object = data_lusc,
                                                    agg_func = mean)

# Clean TCGA-SKCM
clean_expr_matrix_tpm_skcm <- process_expression_matrix(expr_matrix = expr_matrix_tpm_skcm,
                                                        se_object = data_skcm,
                                                        agg_func = mean)

```

Filter clinical data in TCGA-LUAD and TCGA-LUSC.
```{r}
# Filter clinical data TCGA-LUAD
# 1. TCGA-LUAD
meta_luad <- clinical_luad %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, definition, tissue_or_organ_of_origin) %>%
  mutate("group" = case_when(definition %in% c("Metastatic","Additional Metastatic") ~ "Metastatic",
                             definition %in% c("Primary solid Tumor","Recurrent Solid Tumor") ~ "Tumor",
                             definition %in% c("Solid Tissue Normal") ~ "Normal",
                             TRUE ~ definition),
         "geo_accession" = barcode,
         "title" = "LUAD") %>%
  dplyr::select(geo_accession,title,barcode,group) %>%
  `colnames<-`(., c("geo_accession","title","barcode","group"))

# Add factor levels to group
meta_luad$group <- factor(meta_luad$group, levels = c("Normal","Tumor","Metastatic"))

# ---
# 2. TCGA-LUSC
meta_lusc <- clinical_lusc %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, definition, tissue_or_organ_of_origin) %>%
  mutate("group" = case_when(definition %in% c("Metastatic","Additional Metastatic") ~ "Metastatic",
                             definition %in% c("Primary solid Tumor","Recurrent Solid Tumor") ~ "Tumor",
                             definition %in% c("Solid Tissue Normal") ~ "Normal",
                             TRUE ~ definition),
         "geo_accession" = barcode,
         "title" = "LUSC") %>%
  dplyr::select(geo_accession,title,barcode,group) %>%
  `colnames<-`(., c("geo_accession","title","barcode","group"))

# Add factor levels to group
meta_lusc$group <- factor(meta_lusc$group, levels = c("Normal","Tumor","Metastatic"))

# ---
# 3. TCGA-SKCM
meta_skcm <- clinical_skcm %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, definition, tissue_or_organ_of_origin) %>%
  mutate("group" = case_when(definition %in% c("Metastatic","Additional Metastatic") ~ "Metastatic",
                             definition %in% c("Primary solid Tumor","Recurrent Solid Tumor") ~ "Tumor",
                             definition %in% c("Solid Tissue Normal") ~ "Normal",
                             TRUE ~ definition),
         "geo_accession" = barcode,
         "title" = "SKCM") %>%
  dplyr::select(geo_accession,title,barcode,group) %>%
  `colnames<-`(., c("geo_accession","title","barcode","group"))

# Add factor levels to group
meta_skcm$group <- factor(meta_skcm$group, levels = c("Normal","Tumor","Metastatic"))
```

Combine expression matices and meta data tables from TCGA-LUAD and TCGA-LUSC.
```{r}
# Combine expression matrices TCGA-LUAD and TCGA-LUSC
# by column
# Add Symbol columns to both matrices
# TCGA-LUAD
clean_expr_matrix_tpm_luad <- clean_expr_matrix_tpm_luad %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(., var = "Symbol")

# TCGA-LUSC
clean_expr_matrix_tpm_lusc <- clean_expr_matrix_tpm_lusc %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(., var = "Symbol")

# TCGA-SKCM
clean_expr_matrix_tpm_skcm <- clean_expr_matrix_tpm_skcm %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(., var = "Symbol")


combined_expr_matrix_tpm_lung <- merge(clean_expr_matrix_tpm_luad, clean_expr_matrix_tpm_lusc, by = "Symbol")

combined_expr_matrix_tpm_lung_skcm <- merge(combined_expr_matrix_tpm_lung, clean_expr_matrix_tpm_skcm, by = "Symbol")
 
# Combine metadata tables
# by row
combined_meta_lung <- rbind(meta_luad, meta_lusc)

combined_meta_lung_skcm <- rbind(combined_meta_lung, meta_skcm)
```

```{r}
# GSE112509 Nevi vs. Melanoma
# load counts table from GEO
urld <- "https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/download/?format=file&type=rnaseq_counts"
path <- paste(urld, "acc=GSE112509", "file=GSE112509_norm_counts_TPM_GRCh38.p13_NCBI.tsv.gz", sep="&");
tbl <- as.matrix(data.table::fread(path, header=T, colClasses="integer"), rownames="GeneID")

# load gene annotations 
apath <- paste(urld, "type=rnaseq_counts", "file=Human.GRCh38.p13.annot.tsv.gz", sep="&")
annot <- data.table::fread(apath, header=T, quote="", stringsAsFactors=F, data.table=F)
rownames(annot) <- annot$GeneID

# filter only protein-coding gene
annot <- annot[annot$GeneType == "protein-coding",]

# sample selection
gsms <- paste0("00000000000001111111111111111111111111100000000001",
        "11111111111111111111111111111")
sml <- strsplit(gsms, split="")[[1]]

# group membership for samples
gs <- factor(sml)
groups <- make.names(c("Nevi","Melanoma"))
levels(gs) <- groups
sample_info <- data.frame(Group = gs, row.names = colnames(tbl))

# pre-filter low count genes
# keep genes with at least N counts > 10, where N = size of smallest group
# keep <- rowSums( tbl >= 10 ) >= min(table(gs))
# tbl <- tbl[keep, ]
tbl <- tbl[rownames(tbl) %in% rownames(annot),]

# annot must have GeneID and Symbol columns, with rownames(annot) == annot$GeneID
ncbi_to_symbol <- function(gene_ids, annot) {
  symbols <- annot$Symbol[match(as.character(gene_ids), rownames(annot))]
  names(symbols) <- gene_ids
  symbols
}

# usage
gene_symbols <- ncbi_to_symbol(rownames(tbl), annot)
# head(gene_symbols)

# to relabel the count matrix rows directly:
rownames(tbl) <- ncbi_to_symbol(rownames(tbl), annot)

expr_gse112509 <- tbl

myFd2 <- "GSE112509_Nevi_Melanoma"
setwd(myFd2)
meta_gse112509 <- read.csv("Table_MetadataMatrix.csv")
```

```{r}
# --- THE SCALED BOXPLOT FUNCTION ---
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)

plot_comparable_boxplot <- function(expr_matrix, # Symbols in rownames, samples in columns
                                    metadata_df,
                                    target_genes,
                                    title,
                                    ref_group = "Normal",
                                    transform = c("log2", "zscore", "none")) {

  # 0. Initial Setup
  transform <- match.arg(transform)
  colnames(expr_matrix) <- gsub("^X", "", colnames(expr_matrix))

  # 1. Sample Matching Logic
  id_cols <- c("geo_accession", "title", "barcode")
  common_samples <- character(0)

  for (col in id_cols) {
    if (col %in% colnames(metadata_df)) {
      test_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_matrix), metadata_df[[col]])
      if (length(test_samples) > 0) {
        common_samples <- test_samples
        # Important: set rownames based on the match to ensure alignment
        temp_meta <- metadata_df
        rownames(temp_meta) <- temp_meta[[col]]
        metadata_df <- temp_meta
        message("Successfully matched using column: ", col)
        break
      }
    }
  }

  if (length(common_samples) == 0) {
    stop("Error: No overlapping samples found.")
  }

  # 2. Subset and Relevel
  expr_sub <- expr_matrix[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
  meta_sub <- metadata_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  meta_sub$group <- as.factor(meta_sub$group)
  if (ref_group %in% levels(meta_sub$group)) {
    meta_sub$group <- relevel(meta_sub$group, ref = ref_group)
  }

  # 3. Data Transformation
  present_genes <- intersect(target_genes, rownames(expr_sub))
  subset_expr <- expr_sub[present_genes, , drop = FALSE]

  if (transform == "log2") {
    # Calculate log2(TPM + 1)
    processed_expr <- log2(subset_expr + 1)
    y_label <- "Expression [log2(TPM+1)]"
  } else if (transform == "zscore") {
    # Log transform first, then Z-score (standard practice)
    log_expr <- log2(subset_expr + 1)
    processed_expr <- t(apply(log_expr, 1, scale))
    colnames(processed_expr) <- colnames(subset_expr)
    y_label <- "Expression (Z-score)"
  } else {
    processed_expr <- subset_expr
    y_label <- "Expression (Raw)"
  }

  # 4. Pivot Data for ggplot
  data_long <- as.data.frame(t(processed_expr)) %>%
    mutate(Group = meta_sub$group) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(present_genes), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Val") %>%
    mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = present_genes))  # keep facet order stable

  # 5. Define Comparison Pairs (ref_group vs each other level)
  group_names <- levels(meta_sub$group)
  my_comparisons <- list()
  if (length(group_names) >= 2) {
    for (i in 2:length(group_names)) {
      my_comparisons[[i - 1]] <- c(group_names[1], group_names[i])
    }
  }

  # 6. Pre-compute stats + bracket positions PER FACET (per Gene)
  # This is the key fix: stat_compare_means()'s automatic label.y placement
  # is NOT reliably facet-aware when facet_wrap(scales = "free_y") is used,
  # so brackets/labels can be calculated using the wrong y-range and end up
  # drawn outside the visible panel (i.e. "missing"). We compute an explicit
  # y.position for every comparison ourselves, separately within each Gene's
  # own data range, then stat_pvalue_manual() draws exactly at those
  # coordinates. add_significance() guarantees every pair gets a label
  # ("ns" through "****"), never blank.
  # (Note: deliberately NOT using rstatix::add_xy_position() here since it
  # requires rstatix >= 0.6.0 and isn't available in all environments; the
  # manual y.position calculation below achieves the same result.)
  stat.test <- data_long %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    wilcox_test(Val ~ Group, comparisons = my_comparisons) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj")

  gene_ymax <- data_long %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    summarise(y_base = max(Val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  stat.test <- stat.test %>%
    left_join(gene_ymax, by = "Gene") %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    mutate(y.position = y_base + y_base * 0.08 + (row_number() - 1) * (y_base * 0.12)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-y_base)

  # 7. Generate Plot
  p <- ggboxplot(data_long,
                 x = "Group",
                 y = "Val",
                 color = "Group",
                 palette = "npj",
                 add = "jitter",                    # show individual sample points
                 add.params = list(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.5, jitter = 0.2),
                 outlier.shape = NA,                 # avoid double-plotting outliers; jitter already shows all points
                 short.panel.labs = TRUE,
                 panel.labs.font = list(face = "bold")) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test,
                        label = "p.adj.signif",      # always draws a label: ns, *, **, ***, ****
                        hide.ns = FALSE,
                        tip.length = 0.01,
                        bracket.size = 0.4) +
    labs(title = title,
         y = y_label,
         x = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 10),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +  # small extra headroom above computed brackets
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray80"),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 11),
          legend.position = "none") +
    facet_wrap(~Gene)

  return(p)
}


# --- CV (COEFFICIENT OF VARIATION) CALCULATION & COMPARISON HELPER ---
# Companion to plot_comparable_boxplot(): uses the same sample-matching
# logic (geo_accession / title / barcode) and group releveling so it can
# be dropped straight into km_and_barplot_helpers.R.
#
# Requires: install.packages("cvequality")  (Feltz & Miller / Krishnamoorthy & Lee tests)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(cvequality)

calc_cv_stats <- function(expr_matrix,       # Symbols in rownames, samples in columns (TPM)
                           metadata_df,
                           target_genes,
                           ref_group = "Normal",
                           scale = c("raw", "log2"),
                           test_method = c("asymptotic", "mslr"),
                           n_resamples = 1000) {

  scale <- match.arg(scale)
  test_method <- match.arg(test_method)
  colnames(expr_matrix) <- gsub("^X", "", colnames(expr_matrix))

  # 1. Sample matching (identical logic to plot_comparable_boxplot)
  id_cols <- c("geo_accession", "title", "barcode")
  common_samples <- character(0)
  for (col in id_cols) {
    if (col %in% colnames(metadata_df)) {
      test_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_matrix), metadata_df[[col]])
      if (length(test_samples) > 0) {
        common_samples <- test_samples
        temp_meta <- metadata_df
        rownames(temp_meta) <- temp_meta[[col]]
        metadata_df <- temp_meta
        message("Successfully matched using column: ", col)
        break
      }
    }
  }
  if (length(common_samples) == 0) stop("Error: No overlapping samples found.")

  # 2. Subset and relevel
  expr_sub <- expr_matrix[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
  meta_sub <- metadata_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  meta_sub$group <- as.factor(meta_sub$group)
  if (ref_group %in% levels(meta_sub$group)) {
    meta_sub$group <- relevel(meta_sub$group, ref = ref_group)
  }

  present_genes <- intersect(target_genes, rownames(expr_sub))
  subset_expr <- expr_sub[present_genes, , drop = FALSE]

  # NOTE ON SCALE: CV = SD / mean is only meaningful on a true ratio scale
  # with a meaningful zero (raw TPM). log2(TPM+1) shifts/compresses the
  # scale and z-scoring forces mean = 0 (CV undefined), so both distort CV.
  # Default is "raw"; "log2" is offered only if you have a specific reason
  # to compare dispersion on the log scale (interpret with caution).
  if (scale == "log2") {
    subset_expr <- log2(subset_expr + 1)
  }

  data_long <- as.data.frame(t(subset_expr)) %>%
    mutate(Group = meta_sub$group) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(present_genes), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Val") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Val))

  # 3. Descriptive CV per Gene x Group
  cv_summary <- data_long %>%
    group_by(Gene, Group) %>%
    summarise(
      n      = dplyr::n(),
      mean   = mean(Val, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd     = sd(Val, na.rm = TRUE),
      CV     = sd / mean,      # unitless ratio; undefined/unstable if mean ~ 0
      CV_pct = CV * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Gene, Group)

  # 4. Omnibus test for equality of CVs across ALL groups, per gene
  #    - "asymptotic": Feltz & Miller (1996) chi-squared test, fast, best for
  #      larger n per group.
  #    - "mslr": Krishnamoorthy & Lee (2014) modified signed log-likelihood
  #      ratio test with resampled critical values; more reliable for small
  #      or unequal group sizes.
  run_cv_test <- function(x, y) {
    if (test_method == "asymptotic") {
      res <- cvequality::asymptotic_test(x = x, y = y)
      tibble(statistic = res$D_AD, df = length(unique(y)) - 1,
             p.value = res$p_value, method = "Feltz-Miller asymptotic")
    } else {
      res <- cvequality::mslr_test(nr = n_resamples, x = x, y = y)
      tibble(statistic = res$MSLRT, df = NA_real_,
             p.value = res$p_value, method = "Krishnamoorthy-Lee MSLRT")
    }
  }

  cv_test_overall <- data_long %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    group_modify(~ run_cv_test(.x$Val, as.character(.x$Group))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))  # across genes

  # 5. Pairwise CV comparisons: ref_group vs each other group, per gene
  other_groups <- setdiff(levels(meta_sub$group), ref_group)

  cv_test_pairwise <- purrr::map_dfr(present_genes, function(g) {
    purrr::map_dfr(other_groups, function(grp) {
      sub <- data_long %>% filter(Gene == g, Group %in% c(ref_group, grp))
      out <- run_cv_test(sub$Val, as.character(sub$Group))
      out %>% mutate(Gene = g, Comparison = paste(ref_group, "vs", grp), .before = 1)
    })
  }) %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%  # BH within each gene's pairwise set
    ungroup()

  list(
    cv_summary       = cv_summary,       # n, mean, sd, CV, CV_pct per Gene x Group
    cv_test_overall  = cv_test_overall,  # k-group omnibus test per Gene
    cv_test_pairwise = cv_test_pairwise  # ref_group vs each other group, per Gene
  )
}
```


Supplement Figure 1. IRF2 expression levels in melanoma (nevus vs. melanoma) and NSCLC (normal vs. tumor). 
Expression level (in TPM) from TCGA_lung and melanoma_gse112509 do not require side-by-side comparison.

We added more melanoma samples to the clinical cohorts to increase variance.
Download expression tables containing expression levels (in TPM) and metadata.
```{r}
# Download RData 
# load("IRF2_Project_FigureS1.RData")

# Process expression data and metadata are downloaded from RData file already in use in the Shiny app
load("multiple_cohorts_data.RData")

source("FunctionCollection.R")

# Define a list of datasets (unique study ID)
datasets <- c("PHS000452_GSE91061","PRJEB23709","SU2CMARK")

# The clinical and gene expression data is stored as df_tf.
df_tf <- df_tf %>%
  distinct(SampleID, StudyID, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_C1_pre <- df_tf %>% 
  subset(StudyID == datasets[1] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") %>%
  dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_C2_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[2] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_NSCLC_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[3] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

# Combine all pre-tx samples from three cohorts
df_pre <- rbind(df_C1_pre, df_C2_pre, df_NSCLC_pre)

### Create list of patients and studyID
### Separate Cohort 1 into original studies PHS000452 and GSE91061
df_str_C1C2 <- do.call(rbind,strsplit(df_pre$SampleID, "_(?=[^_]*$)", perl = TRUE)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  `colnames<-`(., c("SampleID", "Cohort")) %>%
  subset(Cohort %in% c("C2n5","PRE")) %>%
  mutate(StudyID = meta_df_tf$group[match(.$SampleID,meta_df_tf$barcode)]) %>%
  mutate(StudyID = ifelse(is.na(StudyID), "PRJEB23709", StudyID)) %>%
  mutate(SampleID = ifelse(StudyID == "PRJEB23709",paste0(SampleID,"_",Cohort),SampleID))

### Use this table to filter Cohort 1 in gene expression table

# Create expression matrix from df_tf
# Expression matrix has
# columns = patients
# rows = genes
# values = expression levels in TPM
expr_df_tf <- df_tf %>%
  # Select malanoma cohorts
  subset(StudyID %in% c("PRJEB23709","PHS000452","GSE91061")) %>%
  # Select samples 
  subset(SampleID %in% df_str_C1C2$SampleID) %>%
  # Select Pre-treatment biopsies
  # subset(BiopsyTime == "Pre") %>%
  # Select SampleID and Genes columns
  dplyr::select(-c(PatientID,BiopsyMatch,BiopsyTime,Response,OS_Status,OS_Time,Prior_Tx,Regimen,StudyID)) %>%
  # Transform table using transpose function
  `rownames<-`(.,NULL) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(., var = "SampleID") %>%
  t()
  
meta_df_tf <- df_str_C1C2 %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID,StudyID) %>%
  `colnames<-`(., c("barcode","group"))

# Create metadata table from df_tf
# Metada matrix has
# rows = patients
# columns = geo_accession, title, barcode, group

```

Combine expr_df_tf and expr_gse112509.
```{r}
# Try to combine expression level table of df_tf and gse112509
# A. without batch effect removal

# 1. Convert GSE112509 to dataframe and create Gene column.
# Assign it to df_a
df_a <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(expr_gse112509), var = "Gene")

meta_df_a <- dplyr::select(meta_gse112509, c(barcode,group))

# 2. Process original df_tf
# Because the samples in GSE112509 has nevi (n = 23) and melanoma (n = 57) without other information,
# we can assume that they were collected from patients as routine biopsy before treatment.
# Therefore, samples in original df_tf whose biopsies were collected pre-treatment (BiopsyTime = "Pre")
# and patients never receive any treatment (Prior_Tx = Naive) will be included in this integrated dataset.

# Create expression table as df_b
df_b <- expr_df_tf # %>%
  # # Select malanoma cohorts
  # subset(StudyID %in% c("PRJEB23709","PHS000452","GSE91061")) %>%
  # # Select Pre-treatment biopsies
  # subset(BiopsyTime == "Pre" & Prior_Tx %in% c("Tx_Naive","Ipi_Naive")) %>%
  # # Select SampleID and Genes columns
  # dplyr::select(-c(PatientID,BiopsyMatch,BiopsyTime,Response,OS_Status,OS_Time,Prior_Tx,Regimen,StudyID)) %>%
  # # Transform table using transpose function
  # `rownames<-`(.,NULL) %>%
  # tibble::column_to_rownames(., var = "SampleID") %>%
  # t()

# Create metadata table  
meta_df_b <- meta_df_tf

# meta_df_b$group <- "Melanoma"

# meta_df_b$group <- df_tf$StudyID[match(meta_df_b$barcode, df_tf$SampleID)]

# Convert df_b to dataframe and add Gene column
df_b <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(df_b), var = "Gene")

# Combine the expression tables
combine_df_noCombat <-  inner_join(df_a,df_b, by = "Gene",) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(., var = "Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Combine metadata tables
combine_meta_ab <- rbind(meta_df_a,meta_df_b)

# --- Run PCA and show dotplot ---
res_df_noCombat <- FactoMineR::PCA(t(combine_df_noCombat), graph = FALSE)

# Extract samples and PCA coordinates 
indv_df_noCombat <- res_df_noCombat$ind$coord %>% 
  as.data.frame(.) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(., var = "SampleID") 

# Add Group labels
indv_df_noCombat$group <- combine_meta_ab$group[match(indv_df_noCombat$SampleID,combine_meta_ab$barcode)]

# Draw dotplots 
Fig_PCA_Comb_noCombat <- ggplot(indv_df_noCombat,
       aes(x = Dim.1,
           y = Dim.2,
           color = group)) +
  geom_point()

Fig_PCA_Comb_noCombat

```

Apply Combat_seq function to adjust expression values.
```{r}
combine_meta_ab <- rbind(meta_df_a, meta_df_b)

# Add new batch and group to existing metatable
combine_meta_ab <- combine_meta_ab %>%
  mutate(batch = case_when(group %in% c("Nevus", "Melanoma") ~ 1,
                           group %in% c("PRJEB23709") ~ 2,
                           group %in% c("PHS000452") ~ 3,
                           group %in% c("GSE91061") ~ 4),
         celltype = ifelse(group %in% c("Nevus"),"Nevus", "Melanoma"))


# Apply Combat_seq
library(sva)
combine_df_Combat <- sva::ComBat_seq(counts = combine_df_noCombat, 
                                     batch = combine_meta_ab$batch, 
                                     group = combine_meta_ab$celltype)

# --- Run PCA and show dotplot ---
res_df_Combat <- FactoMineR::PCA(t(combine_df_Combat), graph = FALSE)

# Extract samples and PCA coordinates 
indv_df_Combat <- res_df_Combat$ind$coord %>% 
  as.data.frame(.) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(., var = "SampleID") 

# Add Group labels
indv_df_Combat$group <- combine_meta_ab$group[match(indv_df_Combat$SampleID,combine_meta_ab$barcode)]

# Draw dotplots 
Fig_PCA_Comb_Combat <- ggplot(indv_df_Combat,
       aes(x = Dim.1,
           y = Dim.2,
           color = group)) +
  geom_point()

Fig_PCA_Comb_Combat

```
